note: Scripture authority is the Open Word Bible (OWB), Amharic, Balanced edition (CC0), bundled as library/data/bible/owb-am-b.json.gz and read offline (owb-am). Every Scripture quotation was re-quoted to it verbatim (founder decision, 2026-11-18: Amharic quotes OWB everywhere), replacing the 1962 UBS wording and translator-rendered verses the first edition carried.

A `mined` row is a verbatim OWB span: the whole verse, verses joined, or the shortest span carrying the quoted clause (pieces joined with … where Murray drops words). `self_rendered` rows are quotations Murray recasts to fit his sentence or applies to the reader (person/number changed), places he argues from a KJV word OWB does not use (Job 15:4 'prayer'), and allusions or bare citations left as the translator's prose.
